models.title: Inflation from a consistent price-index series
models.summary: Inflation is the proportional change in the chosen aggregate price index between the stated periods.

relationship.translation_notes: Dimensionless index ratio minus pure1 is a base fractional inflation rate. The same arithmetic as output growth has a different independently defined quantity: aggregate price change rather than real output change. No percent conversion factor is inserted. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.
